facts.text: Grew up in Garland, Texas.
Garland High School; International Baccalaureate; class rank third.
UT Austin, attended 2018-2022; Business Honors, Management Information Systems, Electrical and Computer Engineering; Alpha Kappa Psi.
Born March 9, 2000.
Younger sisters Britney and Bethany.
Roblox product manager, Avatar Marketplace; intern in 2021; converted to Associate Product Manager in 2022.
Previously interned at Frontier Energy. (Oracle was a rescinded internship, never completed; never a correct answer.)
Drives a Genesis G70 3.3T Sport Prestige.
Personal website brandonctran.com; favorite and proudest page is Playground (I Spy-like diorama feel); personal logo features tortoiseshell glasses.
Built a smart mirror for Kim.
Side projects and ideas: Field Day, Self Atlas, Nouri, Clarity, Stacky. Where & When is his photo, location and time guessing game.
First concert: Chance the Rapper, The Bomb Factory, 2016.
Likes NBA 2K; it helped get him into basketball in high school. Has discussed MyTEAM and historically playing it solo; current play style not assumed.
Extensively mods Skyrim, Fallout, The Sims, Assetto Corsa, BeamNG.

Favorite old League pro: Dyrus (corrected Oct 29; the brief said Chaox). Also liked The Rain Man. Stopped playing League regularly after Season 4. Mainly Mid/ADC. Champions: Fizz, Orianna, Ahri, Cassiopeia, Jinx, Caitlyn, Graves, Vayne; his mains were Orianna, Fizz and Ahri (Oct 29). Watched PhantomL0rd and old League-era Sykkuno.
Guitar gear: PRS Silver Sky, Taylor acoustic. Photography: Fujifilm, Peak Design. VR: Meta Quest 3, Valve Index.
Called boredom the hardest part of a 12-mile run.
Has cooked and experimented with Vietnamese/fusion dishes; people call him a great chef while he credits following recipes.
Wants his website to represent his whole identity; compares its different worlds to different films by the same director.

Evan: best friend since 7th grade, best man, same middle/high school/college, college roommate. Sahil: freshman-year roommate. Henry and Ben: cousins (dad side). Richard, Allan, Jeremy: cousins (mom side). Chinh and Khoa: longtime precollege friends. Adi and Chiang: college friends.
Watched all the old League pros and liked TSM a lot, specifically the Reginald, OddOne, Chaox, Xpecial and Dyrus lineup, which he watched quite a bit. Also watched Imaqtpie, Scarra and Voyboy.
Dallas-to-Bay-Area road trip with his sister Bethany.
Brandon and Kim first met in high school Spanish class.
Their first date was at the Dallas Arboretum, in Dallas.
There were actually corgis at the proposal.
The ring was revealed from a corgi flower backpack: it came out of a corgi flower backpack.
Fiancee Kimberly ("Kim"). Dating anniversary May 4, 2018. Wedding planned February 6, 2027, in Austin.
Proposal location: Ritz-Carlton Half Moon Bay. The staged meetup is still unconfirmed (needs Brandon).
First-dance song selected: Dancing in the Kitchen by LANY (possible wedding surprise). Cha-cha felt right for the song. Fred Astaire dance lessons. Instructor: Maksym.
Dog: Winnie Bernard. Male F1b Cavapoo. Apricot coat. Brought home October 4, 2025. Ten weeks old at pickup.
Hides stolen objects under the couch. Once fetched an already-destroyed pillowcase to restart a chase. Trained to press a doorbell button to go outside. Brandon wants to groom him himself.
